svg.title: FIG-01 Current platform layers and product boundary
svg.desc: External product and safety policy; tasks / services / protocols / private layout scheduling, budgets, recovery, shutdown; external TOML assembly Board / backend / instances / budgets; Nexus: reusable mechanisms and maintained providers; Optional components: owner / device / storage ports; optional OS task / wait / notify external task storage and kernel start; Platform: static assembly and shared C coordinator Typed factory / explicit start / stop; I/O: public types / readonly faces / checked dispatch; SoC provider: controller / IRQ / DMA implementation Private state, clock, timebase, memory facts; Arch: CPU primitives and explicit mechanisms mask / barrier / cache / MPU / SAU; Core: status / deadline / request Small common contracts, no hardware registry; Board: pins / oscillators / authorized routes / provenance Build-time facts, no ordinary runtime I/O forwarding; selected MCU / PCB separate physical qualification; resolved generation (build time); facts / authorization (build time); lookup identity / explicit start-stop; direct ordinary I/O; explicit opt-in; explicit opt-in; device access under component contract; shared contracts; wait and time contracts; ops(context, ...) dispatch; checked lifecycle rules; direct CPU primitive calls; request and time rules; selected register / IRQ / DMA access
